mainText: Hello, Verona! At 2 AM, we have clear skies and 59 degree temperatures near the Verona Public Library, accompanied by a beautiful waning crescent moon.
The Public Works Department is working hard on year-round maintenance, and the city reminds everyone that you can stay connected to all municipal updates by subscribing to the digital newsletter.
There is plenty to do in town with live music at Paddy Mac's today, yoga at Insight Wellness today, the farmer's market at Hometown Junction Park today, and trivia at The Bogey Factory today.
On September 28, the police department responded to a motor vehicle crash with injuries at Enterprise Drive and East Verona Avenue involving a juvenile operating an eMoto.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Turtle Cheesecake. The restaurant is currently closed but will open today at 10:00 AM.
